# OmopTrainer

OmopTrainer checks whether an R session has the software, packages, and
data needed for an OMOP training. It reports the checks that pass or
need attention and gives commands or instructions to address common
setup problems. It does not install software or packages automatically.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopTrainer")
```

## Check your setup

Run the validator from an R session:

``` r

OmopTrainer::validateSetup()
```

The default `base` training specification checks that:

- R 4.1 or later is installed.
- Rtools is available on Windows.
- All required R packages are installed. Packages with an explicit
  `(>= version)` requirement must meet that minimum; packages without
  one are not checked for updates.
- The required mock datasets are downloaded and DuckDB is installed.
- Quarto is installed.
- GitHub Desktop is installed.

If packages are missing, the validator prints an
[`install.packages()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)
command to copy into the R console. If an installed package is below its
stated minimum, install it from a repository that provides that version;
the configured repository may not have a suitable release. The validator
does not install anything automatically. Rtools, Quarto, and GitHub
Desktop must be installed separately when required.

## Configure the OMOP data folder

Set `OMOP_DATA_FOLDER` to a local folder where `omock` can store its
mock datasets. The simplest way is to open your user `.Renviron` file:

``` r

usethis::edit_r_environ()
```

Add a line with the path to your folder, for example:

``` text
OMOP_DATA_FOLDER="/Users/your-name/OMOP"
```

On Windows, use a path such as `C:/Users/your-name/OMOP`. Save the file
and restart R so the environment variable takes effect. Run
[`OmopTrainer::validateSetup()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopTrainer/reference/validateSetup.md)
and follow its package installation instructions before downloading
data. The `omock` package must be installed to download the mock
datasets.

Download the datasets required by the default training specification:

``` r

omock::downloadMockDataset("delphi-100k")
omock::downloadMockDataset("synpuf-1k")
```

Run
[`OmopTrainer::validateSetup()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopTrainer/reference/validateSetup.md)
again to confirm the datasets are available.

## Training specifications

The package currently includes a `base` specification. Package
developers can edit the YAML specification in `data-raw/specs/` and
regenerate the internal specification data with
`source("data-raw/specs.R")`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`validateSetup()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopTrainer/reference/validateSetup.md)
  : Validate if the setup for your session has been properly done
